description: This source file defines an enum ToolResultTextFormatter with static methods to parse, analyze, and format JSON-like text outputs, especially for representing status or error messages related to tools. It includes functions to check if text resembles JSON, to render JSON content into human-readable summaries, handle specific node and pairing info, and sanitize error messages.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats input text to a user-friendly message, handling JSON content if detected.

methods.name: looksLikeJSON
methods.description: Checks if a string appears to be JSON based on initial character(s).

methods.name: renderJSON
methods.description: Converts a JSON object into a human-readable summary.

methods.name: renderDictionary
methods.description: Formats a dictionary (Parsed JSON) into text based on its contents.

methods.name: renderNodesSummary
methods.description: Generates a summary of nodes from a dictionary containing node list info.

methods.name: pairingDetail
methods.description: Determines pairing status based on node info.

methods.name: firstString
methods.description: Retrieves the first non-empty string value from a dictionary given a list of keys.

methods.name: sanitizeError
methods.description: Cleans up raw error messages, truncating and removing unnecessary parts.
